goalInOwnWords: Build a line of machines that turns scrap into ingots, fill the orders each shift, and make more money than Sal.
stoppedWhere: Results screen after the second try of game 1 (try from shift 5), after the survey and completion code
stoppedWhy: About a dozen minutes in and I'd had my fill for a break. Beating Sal still feels possible, but I'd come back later, not right now. It is more fiddly than the NYT Mini.

stuck.what: The lit spot for the Furnace was on top of an existing Dock, and placing it pushed the Dock back onto the shelf. I did not understand why.
stuck.gotOutHow: Followed the lit spots and put the Dock where it lit next.

stuck.what: Could not tell how to close a $1,000 gap to the order
stuck.gotOutHow: Did not; missed the order and carried on

confused: Lesson showed '0 ingots' after shift 1 and 2 with money still going up

oneChange: Make it a 3-minute game I can finish on a break, with one clear thing to improve next time, and less text up front.
